shots.intent: 在搜索列表里一眼拿下点击，交代宽松落肩廓形与整身比例。
一秒给出核心利益：落肩垂坠感与大容量插袋，主图一秒法则。
用买家自拍视角完成代入，证明松弛上身效果适合日常外出。
低机位场景镜证明蹲坐不紧绷、日常耐穿，强化生活方式代入。
用背侧结构镜解释帽型与后过肩做工，消除版型与厚度疑虑。
微距特写证明面料质感与织造做工，是视觉驱动品的信任支点。
让买家一次比较两个色路，降低选款犹豫并提升加购。
以空白参数行与结构引线消除尺码与做工疑虑，完成信任收口。

style.backgroundSystem: matte seamless paper cyclorama in warm studio white #FAF7F2 and oatmeal greige #E7E0D6 for on-body screens, one cream fleece-pile field #F5EDE2 for texture and lifestyle screens, one camel matte board #B98A5E reserved for the closing screen; flat fields only, no gradient, no environmental props beyond the two lifestyle anchors
style.iconSystem: single-weight thin line icons and dotted leader lines in deep charcoal #1C1C20, unlettered rounded callout pills and empty stamp frames, no filled glyphs, no badges
style.lightingSystem: bright warm high-key studio light from a large frontal softbox with a left fill card, low skimming side light only where fabric relief must read, soft contact shadows, no harsh speculars and no coloured gels
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium warm-neutral women's loungewear ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of warm studio white #FAF7F2, oatmeal greige #E7E0D6, cream fleece pile #F5EDE2 and one camel accent #B98A5E, with deep charcoal #1C1C20 reserved for hairlines only; bright warm high-key studio lighting from a large frontal softbox with a left fill card, low skimming side light only where fabric relief must read, soft contact shadows and no harsh speculars; modern geometric sans-serif with wide letter spacing; single-weight thin-line icon style with dotted leader lines and unlettered rounded callout pills; matte seamless paper cyclorama and brushed textile pile surfaces, no gradient; clean high-end apparel photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable straight-on or slight 3/4 on-body garment angle with identical drape and scale; no colour palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no colour palette changes away from #FAF7F2, #E7E0D6, #F5EDE2 and #B98A5E
no mixed fonts or handwritten type
no random backgrounds or gradient backdrops
no inconsistent lighting or coloured gels between screens
no filled icons, badges, stars or certification seals
style.presentationRules: on-body garment kept at a stable straight-on or slight 3/4 angle with identical drape, hem and hood always fully in frame, no mannequin, no floating garment, garment never re-proportioned between screens
style.surfaceSystem: matte seamless paper floor and wall in the same tone, cream brushed-pile textile surface for texture screens, camel matte board for the closing flat layout
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif with wide letter spacing, single family only, one headline plus short labels, all rendered copy left as empty reserved space
